title: Implement meter aggregation and bands
description:
Implement aggregation over the records in a resolved window: thanks and F-bomb token counts, message-level counts, messages and sessions scanned, per-source breakdown. Gauge: thanks divided by (thanks plus F-bombs) when the denominator is positive, otherwise a quiet state; bands are config-driven (defaults: at least 0.75 mostly grateful, 0.40 to 0.75 mixed, below 0.40 cursing at the machine).

Done when: aggregation is deterministic, includes the window label, and unit tests cover the gauge, bands, and quiet case.
